blocks.text: NAGOYA, Japan — Under 1,000 spectators watched Asian Games hosts Japan beat South Korea in the semi-finals of the women’s football at a 50,000-capacity stadium, highlighting the struggle to generate interest in some events. It came hours after organisers in Aichi-Nagoya said Tuesday that more than one million tickets had been sold for the continent’s biggest sporting spectacular. Japanese organisers have been on the defensive over attendances ever since the opening ceremony on September 19 took place in front of thousands of empty seats.
